title: chrysopogon nigritanus
intro: Chrysopogon nigritanus, commonly known as Vettiver or Khus-khus, is a type of perennial grass native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating stress. The therapeutic actions of Chrysopogon nigritanus include its sedative, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. Its bioactive constituents include essential oils, such as vetiverol and khusimone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
